parsed_json.up: Select compounds with IC50 measurements in nM against human Isocitrate dehydrogenase [NADP] cytoplasmic. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to match the target. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Join docs via assays.doc_id to obtain publication provenance. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (coalesce DOI and PubMed ID preferring DOI), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Filter by standard_type = 'IC50' and standard_units = 'nM' and target name = 'Isocitrate dehydrogenase [NADP] cytoplasmic' and organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Keep all activity rows without deduplication.
